element of the complex Lie algebra sl₂(ℂ)

V is the complex irreducible highest-weight sl₂(ℂ)-module of highest weight λ, of complex dimension λ+1. The Chevalley generators x,y,h of sl₂(ℂ) act on V and satisfy [h,x]=2x, [h,y]=−2y, [x,y]=h. In its universal enveloping algebra and in the induced operators on V, the bracket is [a,b]=ab−ba; the same symbols denote the corresponding operators.
family of elements of U(sl₂(ℂ)), also denoting their complex-linear actions on V
For every natural number r, X_r=x^r/r! in U(sl₂(ℂ)), also denoting its induced operator on V. The zeroth power is the enveloping algebra identity, acting as Id_V.
family of elements of U(sl₂(ℂ)), also denoting their complex-linear actions on V
For every natural number r, Y_r=y^r/r! in U(sl₂(ℂ)), also denoting its induced operator on V. The zeroth power is the enveloping algebra identity, acting as Id_V.
